Learning the basics — like ABC alphabet, phonics, numbers, and tracing — builds a strong foundation for school or kindergarten. PRE-READING ADVENTURE

Distance Meter is a complete measurement toolkit with AR distance measuring and 9 professional tools — all in one app. Powered by Google ARCore, the app detects your device\'s hardware and selects the best measurement engine for maximum accuracy.

Whether you\'re leveling a shelf, measuring room dimensions, or checking angles, Distance Meter has the right tool for every job.

[9 Measurement Tools]

Distance Meter goes far beyond a simple ruler. It includes 9 specialized tools:

• Bubble Level — Circular spirit level with realistic 3D liquid and bubble animation. Check if surfaces are perfectly horizontal.

• Clinometer — Slope and angle gauge measuring 0° to 90°. Ideal for roofs, ramps, and terrain slopes.

• Plumb Bob — Digital plumb bob with gravity-based pendulum. Verify perfect vertical alignment.

• Protractor — Touch and sensor-based angle measurement from 0° to 180°. Measure angles between objects or surfaces.

• Screen Ruler — On-screen ruler in centimeters and inches. Measure small objects directly on your phone screen.

• Frame Checker — Camera-based frame alignment tool. Check if picture frames, TVs, and shelves are perfectly level.

• Height Meter — AR-powered height measurement. Measure the height of people, furniture, doors, and buildings.

• Width & Height — AR dimension measurement. Get both width and height of objects in a single session.

• Area Calculator — AR multi-point area calculation. Mark corners to calculate floor area, wall space, or any surface.

[Smart Measurement Engine — 4-Tier System]

Your device is automatically matched to the best available engine:

• Premium (ToF/LiDAR) — Hardware depth sensors deliver ±2cm accuracy. Ideal for construction and precise work.

• High (Depth API) — Software depth estimation with ±5cm precision. Available on most modern devices.

• Standard (ARCore) — Surface detection and feature tracking with ±10cm accuracy.

• Basic (Camera) — Camera-based estimation for devices without AR support.

[How to Measure]

1. Tap the Measure button or select a tool

2. Point your camera at the target

3. Wait for the green indicator (optimal conditions)

4. Align the crosshair and tap to measure

5. Results display instantly with estimated accuracy (±cm)

[Real-Time Accuracy Feedback]

Distance Meter monitors 5 conditions in real time:

• Tracking status — Is ARCore actively tracking?

• Lighting — Is the scene well-lit?

• Surface detection — Has a surface been found?

• Feature points — Are enough visual features visible?

• Camera stability — Is the device steady?

[Multi-Strategy Fusion Technology]

This AR ruler combines results from multiple measurement strategies (Depth, Plane, Point Cloud) using confidence-weighted fusion, eliminating outliers and improving accuracy by up to 30%.

[Key Features]

• 9 measurement tools in one app

• 4-tier AR engine (ToF/LiDAR → Depth API → ARCore → Basic)

• 6 units: meters, centimeters, feet, inches, yards, millimeters

• Auto-save measurements to history

• Sound and vibration feedback

• Grid overlay and level indicators

• Dark and light mode support

• Status bar shortcut for quick access

[Tips for Best Results]

• Ensure good lighting (avoid very dark or very bright conditions)

• Move your device slowly during initialization

• Keep a steady hand — stability directly affects accuracy

• Measure textured surfaces (avoid mirrors, glass, solid white walls)

• Optimal AR range: 0.5m to 5m

Your feedback helps us improve. Please leave a review!

[Disclaimer]

Measurement results are estimates based on AR technology and device sensors. Actual distances may vary depending on device, environment, and conditions. This app is not intended for professional surveying or safety-critical applications.

This app allows using your phone as a head tracking device for games on your PC. Works with games which support FreeTrack 2.0 protocol but can also connect directly with Opentrack.

Many flight or racing simulation games support head tracking. HeadTrack on your phone can be your head tracking device, no additional hardware is required. HeadTrack tracks your head movement and rotation which is sent to your games.

The HeadTrack app on your phone supports Gyroscope or Camera as input. The Gyroscope input has very little latency which makes it good for quick movements. The Camera input supports full 6DoF tracking.

Supported Inputs

• HeadTrack (recommended) - Available for Android & iOS with Gyroscope or Camera.

• Opentrack App - Connect any app which is compatible with Opentrack.

• Live Link App - Another alternative iOS app with camera input

Supported Outputs

• FreeTrack (recommended / Windows only) - Head tracking data is sent to games which support FreeTrack 2.0. This should work with most games which support head trackers.

• Opentrack - Head tracking data is sent to Opentrack on this PC. This is useful if you already have Opentrack set up.

• FlightGear - Plugin for FlightGear

• X-Plane - Plugin for X-Plane 9+

Supported Games

Most games which support head tracking should work with HeadTrack. Some games we can confirm are working: Arma 3, BeamNG.drive, FlightGear, X-Plane.

In your game, look into the settings if there is any support for FreeTrack or similar head tracking devices.

How to Play Vita Sort:

Playing Vita Sort is intuitive, with its core mechanics centered around your meticulous observation, clever categorization, and strategic tapping to effectively manage the tiles and collection areas.

1. Tap to Collect: Tap any available Mahjong tile on the board, and it will first move into the temporary tray at the bottom.

2. Activate & Categorize:

- The top of the screen features 3 main category slots, displaying active Mahjong tile categories and their collection progress (e.g., "Characters 2/4").

- When a Mahjong tile enters the temporary tray, if it belongs to a category already represented in one of the main category slots, all matching tiles in the tray will automatically categorize and count towards that main slot's progress.

3. Complete & Clear: Once the number of Mahjong tiles in a main category slot reaches its target requirement, that category will be fully collected and disappear from the slot, freeing up space for new categories.

4. Strategic Planning: The temporary tray has limited space. You need to plan your taps in advance, ensuring each tap effectively contributes to completing a main category. Avoid filling the tray with too many un-categorizable tiles, which could lead to a stalled game.
